profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Exostellar Inc.
profile.summary:
Self-motivated worker with integrity. Very good at multi-tasking. More interested in technical work, coding and problem solving than management. Extensive experience in Linux and C on embedded systems. Several recent projects using golang in a Kubernetes cluster. 

Considering only remote positions.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Highlands Ranch, Colorado, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Develop core features for automatic resource management of a could-native application container platform.

- Developed components interacting with the AWS Cloud SDK using golang and the AWS CLI to automate instance creation/termination. Familiar with most AWS concepts such as IAM roles, Batch, System Manager, etc. Worked on porting the same code over to Azure.
- Implemented a memory detention algorithm in the Linux balloon driver to facilitate migration to larger VM instances.
- Developed new features for the xen/tools OpenSource project in C to improve virtual machine (VM) domain migration performance using multiple threads for streaming. Familiar with xen concepts such as domU configuration and cpuid masking.
- Extensive experience with Linux, including writing system services, configuring boot loaders, and automating tasks using bash or python scripts.
- Developed multi-threaded test framework using python and stress-ng to simulate customer workload CPU load and memory usage over time.
- Developed REST compliant server to handle requests from a front-end UI using python and Flask. OpenAPI compliant framework using Swagger.
- Developed an automated Slurm cluster deployed using Terraform. Experienced with configuring HPC systems using Slurm auto-scalers and LSF resource connectors.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Linux · Python (Programming Language) · Slurm Workload Manager · REST APIs · C

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on a wide range of projects using embedded Linux and C on set-top-box (STB) products.

- Senior member of the security team. Main responsibility to review software vulnerabilities on our STBs and develop libraries to abstract security from other developers.
- Maintain certificate authority (CA) used to access corporate and external servers securely using full peer verification. Code using curl and/or openSSL developed for that purpose.
- Maintain best practices for security in our web server (lighttpd) and firewall. Developed a daemon to auto-configure stunnel to allow developers to obtain a secure socket with minimal effort.
- Developed several fastCGI processes using REST to standardize internal and external communication between processes.
- Responsible for maintaining and patching open source packages. Experienced with configure scripts and GNU make.
- Outstanding debugging and troubleshooting skills. Assigned to solve the most difficult problems and issues that arise in the field.
- Developed OnDemand algorithm to stream MPEG-encoded data from a server, including security keys that allow playback on the STB.
- Developed low-level components running on the vendor side on Android to enable our STBs to transition to that platform. Familiar with SELinux security and policies.

positions.description: Development of embedded telephony products on Unix platforms such as Solaris and Linux. Software coded in C.
